description: The file defines the main route component for a notes application built with Qwik. It manages state variables, fetches notes data, handles user interactions such as add/edit/delete, and composes the UI with sidebar and main content components.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Initiates creation of a new note by setting editing states and selected ID.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new note or updates an existing one, updating the notes list and UI state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note or cancels new note creation.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Enters edit mode for the selected note.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Selects a note by its ID from the sidebar.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Cancels editing or creating a note and resets relevant UI states.
